chapter.neroevents.event_log.title: Event Log
economy_result.neroevents.absent: This needs NeroEconomy, which is not installed on this server.
message.neroevents.supply_beacon_pending: A Supply Beacon is reserved for you. NeroEvents will hand it over once supply drops arrive.
quest.neroevents.event_log.boss_contribu: Pull your weight against a world boss. Meet the contribution floor when the giant falls and the record is yours.
quest.neroevents.event_log.first_call.de: Take part in your first server event and see it through to the end. Any event counts, as long as you did your share.
quest.neroevents.event_log.giant_slain.d: The whole server, together: bring down a world boss. Logged once for the world the first time one falls.
quest.neroevents.event_log.raid_repelled: Hold the line when a raid comes. Be among the defenders when the last raider falls.
quest.neroevents.event_log.seasoned_serv: Twenty-five events resolved on this world. A server that has seen a few things.
quest.neroevents.event_log.supply_run.de: Reach a supply drop and claim it before anyone else does. The event log remembers who got there.
quest.neroevents.event_log.world_first_e: The first event on this world has run its course. Every server's history starts somewhere.
